review_description: Hi. If your reading this your obviously looking at putting a system in.I got several quotes and researched the systems on offer. Green Solar was our choice of Companies with  good reviews and pricing structure.We have no hesitation in recommending Paul and his team from Green Solar for their expert service and quality finish to their work.Cheers. Rod and Kathy.

Everything dealing with this company has been great. i had an issue last year, and it wasn't caused by the solar install. But Paul was more than happy to come out and assist at no charge and provide a letter of investigation which helped with my electricity provider. Will happily recommend to friends and family.

Amazing experience from start to finish.Paul was (and still is!) responsive to every question I have. The installers - Reece, Joey and the crew were on time, polite, really tidy and always ready to help.We're delighted with the result and would recommend Green Solar to anyone.
Great service and installation. Friendly and explains everything.  Showed up on time and installation went really well.
All of the above was good.  They did everything promptly and professionally.
Absolutely brilliant company from first phone call to follow up following installation. Took time to answer every question in detail before installation, on day of and after installation.
All processes went according to plan and the timeline was adhered to.

Paul and Green Solar were fantastic to deal with. He contacted me the day after we submitted a quote request and was informative and communicative the whole way through. All our questions were answered and great advice given. Nothing was too much trouble. The installation team were great and got the system up and working quickly, tidily and with no problems.I had already received a quote from another supplier and Green Solar gave us a bigger and better system for the same money. 5 stars all round!!

Took multiple solar quotes and Green solar stood out with both an in-house installation team and Brian who I talked to giving a heap of great solar information so we could be confident in the brands we chose. Turn around was super quick and the crew did a great job. Also wasn't any more expensive than the other quotes we got from companies that are just acting as middlemen.

My existing system finally died after almost 15 years - TC Alfred didn't help the process.  I found Green Solar via my energy supplier's website - prompt and helpful responses, they worked around my timetable (I work from home on a Monday) for both inspection of the old system and for the replacement - I had done some background research on what a likely replacement cost would be - Green Solar's quote came in pretty much where I had thought it would land.The installers turned up exactly on time and worked in persistent rain/drizzle to remove the old panels - not fun on a slippery iron roof.  The guys were polite, cheerful and clearly enjoy working as a team, gave me plenty of notice when the mains power would need to go off, linked up the inverter to wifi and gave me all the details for accessing the app.  Cleaned up after themselves and then left - just as the sun started shining - so those panels were working straight away.The follow-up communication has been equally as good - invoice received, paid and payment acknowledged.  I received email confirmation of the app log in details and I've not had to worry about anything.  They have dealt with my energy supplier and sorted the rebates - seamless, painless - absolutely earning those 5 stars.
Great team and real honest advice.  Great to find a team you can trust.I was provided detailed advice and options.Install team sensational

What can I say other than outstanding service and installation.  Right from the beginning talking with Paul it was an informative and straight forward conversation.  All my questions were answered and a competitive quotation prepared to my specifications.  Keen pricing..........and professionalism to the "T" from the instal team.  Arrived around 8:30am this morning and finished and done to a high standard by 1pm. Explained everything fully and answered any questions that I had about the install.  AwesomeA great experience from start to finish and I highly recommend them for competitive pricing and prompt professional service all round.

Great Bunch of Guys. Great Price too. Nothing was too much trouble. Before during and after work, contact is consistent not like some people who get hard to contact, not with this company. Highly recommend them. They only suggest and use great known products you can trust. With a long guarantee.

From my first chat with Brian at Green Solar, I was impressed by his professionalism, knowledge and friendliness. Brian took the time to thoroughly explain every aspect of the solar system, from the initial design process and our requirements, through to installation. It was clear he was not only knowledgeable but genuinely interested in helping us make the best choice for our energy needs.Brian patiently answered all of my questions, no matter how small, ensuring I felt comfortable and informed every step of the way. Highly recommend them to anyone making the switch to solar.

Exceptional work in completing the project efficiently.Brian has provided comprehensive and valuable information regarding the quotation. Paul has contributed significant technical expertise, particularly in the installation of the switch box, which has proven to be a worthwhile investment.

Paul and the team did an excellent job, were punctual and tidy and the system is working to full expectations Paul was there throughout the process, giving honest advice and providing a number of options. I highly recommend Green Solar and will refer to friends and family.

Really happy with these guys. The whole process was super easy, the team were friendly and polite, and the system they installed is top quality. Price was really fair too—felt like great value for what we got. Would definitely recommend to anyone thinking about going solar.
Green Solar are dedicated to the industry and take great care in providing customised advice, a quality product and reliable service.

The salesperson, Brian was knowledgeable and gave me factual information on the best size system which wasn't the largest and some pushed which would just send up taking longer to pay back for little gain.  Follow up questions were all answered and a competitive price. Install was hassle free.Just some tips for others:A larger system would have made me exempt from solar tariff for some suppliers so be careful.I think one thing not discussed by all suppliers is peak demand. You might have a large system but if you have a number of items drawing power for a short or medium time you will import electricity for that time while on average it all looks rosey. However need to balance what max system supplier will still pay you a solar tarrif.
Install team were great, good price. It’s performing well. All very simple.

The review of our past system was very polite and factual. We chose a 10kWt system. Richie installed our new system and his service was excellent.We are now averaging 45kWt per day.This is a fantastic company who we would recommend to anybody.Thanks for the service.

Their initial communication was quick to respond to an email, and informative to any question.Installation happened on time and seemed quite quick to me.Price was fairer or equal to other quotes.

Green Solar were amazing to deal with throughout the entire process. they turned up ontime and did all they said they wouldI was very happy with the way it went and with the results

The whole process was seamless on our recent install. Looking forward to reduced power bills.

Breaking free from our big power bills.  When we finally decided to make the switch to solar, we shopped around a bit but most companies had only been around a few months to a year at most until we discovered Green Solar and soon got in contact with Paul Thistleton. He’s been in the industry for years, very upfront about what works and what doesn't, provided several solutions for us, and explained everything about the process involved. We went with the  GoodWe 6000 MS3 MPP T’s single-phase 7.6 kW Inverter (Industry-leading smart consumption metered inverter, with a 10-year warranty, also offers up to 100% DC input oversizing) matched with 16 x Jinko Tiger Neo N Type 475w solar panels (Premium utility-scale panels, with a 10-year warranty, and most efficient conversion ratios for low and high range light conditions as well as back-side panel reflected light absorption). Fully installed on time and under budget for less than $6k. It’s been 3 months since we switched in late June 2023 and our quarterly power bill has dropped from $450 to just $72 for the period Jul-Sep on the basis of 9 kWh average daily usage for a 5-bedroom home with 7 split air conditioners. We didn’t change our living habits and enjoyed being kept informed about the performance and savings we were making with the SEMS smart app included for free with the package. We highly recommend contacting Green Solar as the choice installer and supplier of quality Solar Power solutions.
Installed in a timely manner as the way that we discussed.
